reviewBody: We hired Bay City Remodeling for a complete overhaul of our home, and the experience was fantastic. They managed everything from design to execution with professionalism and care. Their team was excellent at communicating updates and addressing any concerns we had. The remodel included everything from flooring to lighting, and each element came together beautifully. Our home feels brand new, and we couldn’t be more satisfied with the final outcome. Bay City Remodeling truly exceeded our expectations!
